messages:
mira: quick note from rk-lite-v2 int8 bringup: overall ndcg OK but MRR drop focused on 1-3 token queries.
jon: short queries often tokenization. which tokenizer did int8 use?
mira: tok-fast v1.2 in int8 path, fp16 used python tokenizers.
arcady: run fp16 with tok-fast and int8 with python tokenizer to isolate.
sasha: also add per-length buckets + bootstrap CI.
mira: did that. swapping tokenizer explains ~90% of the 1-token MRR drop. will file checklist PR to pin tokenizer for evals and canary.
jon: good. add short-query smoke (1-3 tokens) before canary and a top1_flip_rate metric.
arcady: consider a small compat shim in tok-fast for edge punctuation rather than forcing python everywhere.
mira: ACK, filing RK-8809 (tokenizer audit) and RK-8810 (short-query smoke). will post diffs when PR ready.
